claim: CloudWatch has metric alarms (one metric or a math expression), PromQL alarms (a PromQL instant query on metrics ingested through the CloudWatch OTLP endpoint), log alarms (a scheduled CloudWatch Logs Insights query) and composite alarms (a rule over other alarms' states).

evidence.quote: A *metric alarm* watches a single CloudWatch metric or the result of a math expression based on CloudWatch metrics.
evidence.title: Using Amazon CloudWatch alarms

evidence.quote: A *log alarm* monitors the results of a CloudWatch Logs Insights query that runs on a schedule.
evidence.title: Using Amazon CloudWatch alarms

evidence.quote: A *composite alarm* includes a rule expression that takes into account the alarm states of other alarms that you have created.
